Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Farhan Tiwari. I am a 70-year-old college lecturer living in Kolkata. M/s Trident Traders gave me a cheque for Rs 31,00,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. My case number is S.C.C. No. 2222/2022 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kolkata. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 75651 22469 or email farhan.tiwari@example.com.
